description: This file defines a factory class `DefaultHttpRequestActorPropsFactory` that implements the `HttpRequestActorPropsFactory` interface. It provides a method to generate `Props` for Akka HTTP request actors, configuring them with provided parameters such as actor references, HTTP request data, response futures, and configuration objects.

classes.name: DefaultHttpRequestActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating `Props` for HTTP request actors in an Akka-based system. It implements the `HttpRequestActorPropsFactory` interface and provides the `props` method to configure actor properties with necessary parameters.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an `Akka` `Props` object for an HTTP request actor, configured with the provided actor reference, header translator, HTTP request, response future, and configuration objects.
